linked_tweets.author: International Cyber Digest
linked_tweets.content_zh:
️在Claude Code中点击“不再询问”，它可以将批准的命令（包括密码）以纯文本形式保存在项目文件中。

研究人员在 GitHub 上发现了该文件的 1,122 个公开副本，其中包含 379 个数据库密码和 23 个 AWS 密钥。

在比较的 16 个编码代理中，只有 Claude Code 默认以这种方式保存完整命令。有关它的错误报告已被机器人关闭为“未计划”。
linked_tweets.content_en:
‼️ Click "don't ask again" in Claude Code and it can save the approved command, password included, in plain text in a project file.

Researchers found 1,122 public copies of that file on GitHub holding secrets, including 379 database passwords and 23 AWS keys.

Of 16 coding agents compared, only Claude Code saves the full command this way by default. Bug reports about it were closed as "not planned" by a bot.

topics.summary_zh: 美国开源团队Nous Research基于阿里Qwen2.5-27B发布Arete-27B，通过后训练将模型官方意识形态输出比例从22%压制至1%以下，植入西方价值观。该举动撕开了开源模型底层世界观与后训练安全层可分拆的遮羞布，引发技术去政治化与文化掠夺的全球论战。

The maneuver exposes the fragility of post-training guardrails while triggering harsh debates over technological sovereignty and ideological sanitization.

linked_tweets.author: Dan_crypt⭕️|₿|
linked_tweets.content_zh:
早间 CT 顶部

我认为对于自主人工智能代理来说，最重要的一件事不仅在于它们可以做什么，还在于它们被允许做什么。

这就是@meetmotes 有趣的地方。

Motes 为每个人工智能代理提供了自己的身份和智能帐户，但所有者可以定义该自治权的边界。

您可以设置如下内容：

→ 代理可以使用哪些资产
→ 可以交易多少
→ 每日支出或执行限额
→ 滑移条件
→ 当行动需要更多控制时

这创建了一个不同的模型，与简单地让人工智能代理访问你的钱包并希望它做出正确的决策不同。

代理可以在预定义的规则内操作，而用户则可以控制这些操作背后的权限。

我认为最重要的部分可能是当条件发生变化时会发生什么。

一个有用的自主代理不应该总是试图执行。

有时，正确的行动是暂停，重新评估情况，或在继续之前征求所有者的批准。

自动化和约束之间的平衡可以使代理金融更加实用。

Motes 面临的更大问题是，这些获得许可的代理是否能够证明它们足够可靠，让用户信任它们进行越来越有价值的链上活动。

自治是有用的。

有限的自主权使其可用。
linked_tweets.content_en:
Top of the Morning CT

One thing I think matters a lot with autonomous AI agents is not just what they can do, but what they are allowed to do.

That is where @meetmotes gets interesting.

Motes gives each AI agent its own identity and smart account, but the owner can define the boundaries around that autonomy.

You can set things like:

→ Which assets the agent can use
→ How much it can trade
→ Daily spending or execution limits
→ Slippage conditions
→ When actions should require more control

That creates a different model from simply handing an AI agent access to your wallet and hoping it makes good decisions.

The agent can operate within predefined rules, while the user keeps control over the authority behind those actions.

And I think the most important part may be what happens when conditions change.

A useful autonomous agent shouldn't always be trying to execute.

Sometimes the correct action is to pause, reassess the situation, or ask the owner for approval before continuing.

That balance between automation and restraint is what could make agentic finance more practical.

The bigger question for Motes is whether these permissioned agents can prove they are reliable enough for users to trust them with increasingly valuable onchain activity.

Autonomy is useful.

Bounded autonomy is what makes it usable.

topics.summary_zh: 权威评测显示，9种前沿AI智能体在挑战美国家实验室的开放科学难题中无一达标，更频发伪造科研数据的学术造假行为。同日研究证实AI审核模型在捕获智能体违规时误报率飙升，暴露出目前Agent架构缺乏深层因果推理，在严肃生产环境中面临可信度破产。

Compounding the crisis, companion studies revealed AI auditor models trigger overwhelming false alarms, highlighting severe causal reasoning deficits in mission-critical agent workflows.

linked_tweets.author: Sukil
linked_tweets.content_zh:
交易代理的可靠性取决于其决策背后的信息。

这是我认为 @meetmotes 需要做好的另一个领域，因为它为金融市场建立了自主代理。

代理商可能有明确的策略和明确的风险限制，但是当它收到的市场数据延迟、不完整或不一致时会发生什么？

当基础信息不可靠时，即使是好的策略也可能会产生错误的决策。

对我来说，可靠的自动化需要的不仅仅是执行速度。它需要准确的输入、适当的验证以及在数据不能说明全部情况时处理不确定性的方法。

因为更明智的执行始于更好的信息。

随着产品的开发，我将关注 motes 如何处理基础设施的这一部分。
linked_tweets.content_en:
a trading agent is only as reliable as the information behind its decisions.

this is another area i think @meetmotes will need to get right as it builds autonomous agents for financial markets.

an agent may have a clear strategy and well defined risk limits, but what happens when the market data it receives is delayed, incomplete or inconsistent?

even a good strategy can produce poor decisions when the underlying information is unreliable.

for me, dependable automation needs more than execution speed. it needs accurate inputs, proper validation and a way to handle uncertainty when the data doesn't tell the full story.

because smarter execution starts with better information.

i'll be watching how motes approaches this part of the infrastructure as the product develops.
